DECLARE @ProductIdList TABLE (ProductId INT NOT NULL)
DECLARE @SuperVoucherDescriptionList TABLE
(
	ProductId INT NOT NULL,
	ProductVersionId INT NOT NULL,
	TemplateVersion INT NOT NULL
)

INSERT INTO @ProductIdList
SELECT DISTINCT P.Id ProductId
FROM Product P
INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId
INNER JOIN ProductSuperVoucherTemplate PSVT ON PV.Id = PSVT.ProductVersionId AND DescriptionContent IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO @SuperVoucherDescriptionList
SELECT P.Id ProductId, PV.Id ProductVersion, MAX(PSVT.Version) TemplateVersion
FROM Product P
INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
INNER JOIN ProductSuperVoucherTemplate PSVT ON PV.Id = PSVT.ProductVersionId
WHERE P.Id IN (SELECT ProductId FROM @ProductIdList)
GROUP BY P.Id, PV.Id

SELECT
	T.ProductId product_id,
	PSVT.DescriptionContent description_content,
	PSVT.CreatedBy created_by,
	PSVT.VersionTime created_on,
	PSVT.Version version
FROM ProductSuperVoucherTemplate PSVT
INNER JOIN @SuperVoucherDescriptionList T ON PSVT.ProductVersionId = T.ProductVersionId AND PSVT.Version = T.TemplateVersion

INSERT INTO ProductTemplateMigration2 ([ProductId], [ProductVersionId], [TemplateType], [TemplateSubType], [ProductTemplateSetId], [TemplateVersionId], [ProductTemplateTagValueId])
SELECT p.Id ProductId, pv.Id ProductVersionId, 1 TemplateType, 1 TemplateSubType, etvs.Id ProductTemplateSetId, etvs.EmailTemplateVersionId TemplateVersionId, etvs.EmailTemplateTagValueId ProductTemplateTagValueId
FROM Product p
INNER JOIN ProductVersion pv ON p.Id = pv.ProductId AND pv.IsCurrentVersion = 1
INNER JOIN ProductEmailTemplateVersion etv ON pv.ProductEmailTemplateVersionId = etv.Id
INNER JOIN ProductEmailTemplateVersionSet etvs ON etv.Id = etvs.ProductEmailTemplateVersionId
UNION ALL
SELECT p.Id ProductId, pv.Id ProductVersionId, 2 TemplateType, 2 TemplateSubType, stvs.Id ProductTemplateSetId, stvs.SLMSTemplateVersionId TemplateVersionId, stvs.SLMSTemplateTagValueId ProductTemplateTagValueId
FROM Product p
INNER JOIN ProductVersion pv ON p.Id = pv.ProductId AND pv.IsCurrentVersion = 1
INNER JOIN ProductSLMSTemplateVersion stv ON pv.ProductSLMSTemplateVersionId = stv.Id
INNER JOIN ProductSLMSTemplateVersionSet stvs ON stv.Id = stvs.ProductSLMSTemplateVersionId
ORDER BY ProductId, TemplateType, ProductTemplateSetId

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[ProductTemplateMigration2]') AND type in (N'U'))
BEGIN
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ProductTemplateMigration2](
	[ProductId] [int] NULL,
	[ProductVersionId] [int] NULL,
	[TemplateType] [int] NULL,
	[TemplateSubType] [int] NULL,
	[ProductTemplateSetId] [int] NULL,
	[TemplateVersionId] [int] NULL,
	[ProductTemplateTagValueId] [int] NULL,
	[TXCProductTemplateSetId] [int] NULL,
	[TXCTemplateVersionId] [int] NULL,
	[TXCProductTemplateTagValueId] [int] NULL
) ON [PRIMARY]
END

TRUNCATE TABLE ProductTemplateMigration2;

DECLARE @MaxProductTemplateSetId INT
DECLARE @MaxProductTemplateTagValueId INT
DECLARE @AdjustProductTemplateSetId INT
DECLARE @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId INT

SELECT @MaxProductTemplateSetId = MAX(ProductTemplateSetId), @MaxProductTemplateTagValueId = MAX(ProductTemplateTagValueId) FROM ProductTemplateMigration2

IF @MaxProductTemplateSetId < 1000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateSetId = 1000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateSetId < 10000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateSetId = 10000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateSetId < 100000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateSetId = 100000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateSetId < 1000000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateSetId = 1000000

IF @MaxProductTemplateTagValueId < 1000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId = 1000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateTagValueId < 10000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId = 10000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateTagValueId < 100000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId = 100000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateTagValueId < 1000000
	SET @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId = 1000000

UPDATE ProductTemplateMigration2 SET
	TXCProductTemplateSetId = ProductTemplateSetId + @AdjustProductTemplateSetId,
	TXCProductTemplateTagValueId = ProductTemplateTagValueId + @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId
WHERE TemplateType = 1

UPDATE ProductTemplateMigration2 SET
	TXCProductTemplateSetId = ProductTemplateSetId + @AdjustProductTemplateSetId * 2,
	TXCProductTemplateTagValueId = ProductTemplateTagValueId + @AdjustProductTemplateTagValueId * 2
WHERE TemplateType = 2

UPDATE ProductTemplateMigration2 SET TXCTemplateVersionId = m.ExternalId
FROM TXCEmailTemplateVersionMapping m
WHERE ProductTemplateMigration2.TemplateVersionId = m.EmailTemplateVersionId
AND ProductTemplateMigration2.TemplateType = 1

UPDATE ProductTemplateMigration2 SET TXCTemplateVersionId = m.ExternalId
FROM TXCSLMSTemplateVersionMapping m
WHERE ProductTemplateMigration2.TemplateVersionId = m.SLMSTemplateVersionId
AND ProductTemplateMigration2.TemplateType = 2

DECLARE @MaxProductEmailTemplateVersionId INT
DECLARE @MaxProductSLMSTemplateVersionId INT
DECLARE @MaxProductTemplateVersionId INT
DECLARE @AdjustId INT

SELECT @MaxProductEmailTemplateVersionId = MAX(ProductEmailTemplateVersionId), @MaxProductSLMSTemplateVersionId = MAX(ProductSLMSTemplateVersionId) FROM ProductTemplateMigration
IF @MaxProductEmailTemplateVersionId >= @MaxProductSLMSTemplateVersionId
	SET @MaxProductTemplateVersionId = @MaxProductEmailTemplateVersionId
ELSE
	SET @MaxProductTemplateVersionId = @MaxProductSLMSTemplateVersionId

IF @MaxProductTemplateVersionId < 1000
	SET @AdjustId = 1000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateVersionId < 10000
	SET @AdjustId = 10000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateVersionId < 100000
	SET @AdjustId = 100000
ELSE IF @MaxProductTemplateVersionId < 1000000
	SET @AdjustId = 1000000

UPDATE ProductTemplateMigration
SET TXCProductTemplateVersionId1 = ProductEmailTemplateVersionId + @AdjustId,
TXCProductTemplateVersionId2 = ProductSLMSTemplateVersionId + (@AdjustId * 2)

SELECT

SELECT

	S.SLMSTemplateTagValueId + 200000 product_template_tag_value_id,
	TVS.ContentTagId tag_id,
	TVS.Value value,
	CONVERT(NVARCHAR, NULL) text_value
FROM ProductTemplateMigration M
